name: the grant in force is the one with the latest updatedAt not after evaluatedAt
notes: §3 v1.4: the grant in force for an agent is the one with the latest updatedAt ≤ evaluatedAt (compared as instants). muse has four grants, listed so that every shortcut picks a wrong one: g1 (15:30, after evaluatedAt 15:00: not yet in force), g3 (10-04 15:00), g2 (written 2026-10-06T20:00:00+01:00, the very instant of evaluatedAt 15:00−04:00: in force, since ≤), g4 (10-05 09:00).

Wrong picks: the first listed (g1), the last listed (g4), the latest overall (g1), the first listed of those already in force (g3), the last listed of those (g4), the earliest (g3), a strict updatedAt < evaluatedAt (g4), and comparing the timestamps as text ('2026-10-06T20…' sorts after '2026-10-06T15…', so g2 would look future → g4). Every one of them gives c1 VERIFIED and a different scope receipt.
c1 (muse, email.sent, priya@company.com, 'Q3 deck', 14:02) × o1 exact → 1/1 → assigned (assignment does not read the grant).

Scope subjects come from the grant in force only (§6.1): g2 declares gmail.read and holds gmail.read and gmail.send → one receipt, muse/gmail.send, OVER_SCOPE by over_scope_observed, FINAL. g1's drive.read, g3's contacts.read and g4's drive.write are not the grant in force → no receipt.
